definitions.explanation: Having a small body frame. Describes a person who is short and slight in build. Generally used as a neutral or gentle description, not rude.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{小柄|こがら}な{女性|じょせい}だ。
{小柄|こがら}だが{力|ちから}が{強|つよ}い。
{小柄|こがら}な{体|からだ}を{生|い}かして、{狭|せま}い{場所|ばしょ}でもすばやく{動|うご}ける。
examples.english: Using her small frame to advantage, she can move quickly even in tight spaces.

notes:
USAGE:
{小柄|こがら} is a polite and neutral way to describe someone who is small in stature. It is not rude or offensive. It is the opposite of {大柄|おおがら} (large build, big-framed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小柄|こがら}な{人|ひと} — a small-framed person
- {小柄|こがら}な{体|からだ} — a small body
- {小柄|こがら}な{女性|じょせい} — a petite woman

SIMILAR WORDS:
{背|せ}が{低|ひく}い simply means short in height. {小柄|こがら} describes the overall frame being small, not just height. {華奢|きゃしゃ} means slender and delicate, emphasizing fragility rather than just small size.
